{{Top}}
'''Taskmasters''' were employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to watch over prisoners in the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of [[Sevarcos II]]. They were typically prisoners themselves who had proven themselves capable of forcing other prisoners to work harder.
